title: The middle false comparison separates coefficient transport and exchange
statement: For finite commutative A, normalized twist transport and i:X isomorphic to P1 over S, middleComparison false followed by inverse image of projectionExchange false equals inverse image of the shifted-line inverse through the second projection, followed by inverse supported self-exchange and inverse image of proper forget-supports, the direct-image compositor and pushPull, followed by the pullback compositor at the splitting target. The precise equality is the Lean statement [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data] [lem-sf-p1-chart-exchange].

source.place: First-coordinate coefficient normalization followed by composition of exchange maps.

proof.text: Apply the normalized finite shifted-line square to the second-projection commutative square for i times_S i. Cancel the three line isomorphisms with a generic inverse-square lemma. This identifies coefficientComparison.inv followed by the pulled-back opposite-projection line inverse.

Expand middleComparison and projectionExchange. Prove the naturality expansion and map-factor pasting together for abstract functors, then specialize once to the shifted-line coefficient square and exchangeIsoTransport. This avoids comparing concrete derived functor implementations while joining two specialized equations.

proof_origin.place: N2: proved shifted-line coefficient square and categorical pasting with the coefficient-independent exchange equation.

from.place: Coefficient normalization and geometric exchange in the first-coordinate transport.

theorem middle_exchange
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) :
    middleComparison A N hA t f i hi hS false ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
          (projectionExchange A N hA t S hS false) =
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (projection f false)).map
          ((ordinaryFinitePullback A (pullback.snd f f)).map
            (ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t i.hom
              (finiteP1_unitOnPullback N (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) hS)).inv) ≫
        (SfDiagonalKernel.exchangeFirst A f).inv.app
          ((ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj
            ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).map
          ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).hom.app
              ((ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj
                ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) ≫
            (rightDerivedLowerStarCompOfEq (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i.hom
              (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) f hi).inv.app
                ((ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).obj
                  ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) ≫
            (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map
              ((pushPull A i).hom.app
                ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))) ≫
        (leftDerivedUpperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i.hom
          (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) f hi.symm).hom.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj
              ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
